# billy

> billy is a completely free, open source, web-based invoice editor for freelancers and small businesses, currently on a waitlist. You click any field on the invoice and type, then export a print-ready PDF.

## Keywords
free invoice generator, open source invoice editor, PDF invoice maker, invoice templates, no watermark, no sign-up fees

## Status
- Not yet launched. Early access is by waitlist at https://trybilly.tech.
- Contact: hello@trybilly.tech
